## Skipped / not vendored
- Open Props `props.colors.min.css` (colour ramp) — skipped per the research pack: collides with the existing hand-tuned OKLCH neutral system in `gamma_cockpit_ui.py`.
- GSAP — **not vendored by policy**: GreenSock's "Standard No-Charge" license is not OSI-approved (MIT/ISC/Apache/OFL-class only, repo is public). anime.js v4 (MIT) is the vendored motion engine instead.
- uPlot / any chart library — decision already shipped (hand-rolled SVG sparklines/bars/org-graph); not re-litigated here.
- particles.js — optional ambient-background candidate from the research pack, not vendored: no tile in the redesign spec currently calls for a particle background, and every byte here is a byte the page always pays even if unused.
- InterVariable.woff2 (single variable file, ~300-400KB) — too big for the font budget; 3 static Inter weights (400/500/600) via the `@fontsource/inter` npm repack total 72,388 B instead, well under it.

All 59 requested Lucide icon names resolved on lucide-static@1.40.0 — none 404d, none skipped.
